You checked the mirror, looked over your shoulder and still nearly collided with the car next to you. An active blind spot system not only alerts you to the presence of a vehicle to your sides or rear but helps prevent you from making an unsafe lane change. Replace fear and uncertainty with the confidence and safety of the Active blind spot system. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. description: The 2021 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray is a mid-engine two-seat sports car with a low, compact profile and a driver-focused cabin. Its proportions place the passenger compartment far forward relative to the rear-mounted powertrain, and the bodywork follows the compact stance associated with the model line. The exterior surfaces are shaped with a clear emphasis on airflow management and mechanical packaging rather than decorative detail, and the overall appearance reflects the placement of the engine behind the occupants. The cabin sits within a rigid structure that supports the car's performance-oriented design, while the roofline and side glass maintain a tight, enclosed feel. Access is through long doors that open wide enough to make entry and exit manageable for a vehicle of this type.Inside, the Corvette Stingray uses a two-seat interior trimmed with leather seats. The seating position is low, and the driver faces a cockpit arranged around a compact instrument area and a central control stack that divides the two occupants. Primary controls are grouped within reach, and the surfaces around the seating area present a mix of soft-touch and harder materials typical of a modern sports car. The cabin includes a head up display, which places selected driving information in the forward field of view. Storage is limited, as expected in a car with this shape and purpose, but the interior still provides the basic conveniences needed for daily use, including a center console area and door pockets.The infotainment system includes navigation and Apple CarPlay. The display is mounted within the center of the dashboard and is integrated with the vehicle's main interface, where audio, communication, and route guidance are controlled. A premium audio system is included, and the cabin also has a Wi-Fi hotspot. These features are arranged in a way that keeps the main controls within the driver's reach while leaving the passenger side relatively uncluttered. The digital elements are paired with physical buttons and switches for core functions, which helps reduce reliance on the screen alone. The system layout is straightforward, with menus and connectivity functions presented through the central display rather than spread across multiple separate interfaces.The Stingray's driving hardware reflects its role as a performance car, with the engine located behind the seats and power delivered through the rear wheels. The chassis and suspension are tuned for responsive handling, and the car's dimensions contribute to a low center of gravity and a compact footprint. Large wheels, wide tires, and braking hardware are part of the standard presentation of the model, and the visible cooling openings in the bodywork support the mechanical demands of the powertrain. The result is a car built around its mechanical components, with each major system placed to serve that purpose. On the road, the available equipment supports both short trips and longer drives, with the cabin technology and seating materials providing a practical level of comfort alongside the car's core performance capabilities.
